# [Enhancement] Standardize Markdown tables across all study plans

**Task Description:**
Audit and standardize the formatting of all Markdown tables within the `/plans/` directory.

**Requirements:**

- Ensure consistent alignment (e.g., left-aligned headers and content).
- Use clean Markdown spacing (one space before and after the `|` separators).
- Verify that header naming conventions are consistent across `1-month-plan.md`, `2-week-plan.md`, and `last-minute-review.md`.

**Files to Audit:**

- `plans/1-month-plan.md`
- `plans/2-week-plan.md`
- `plans/last-minute-review.md`

**Definition of Done:**

- [ ] All tables in the `/plans/` directory follow the same stylistic standards.
